task.description: Design and implement tests for IDN-04 API token management. Create or update tests/specs/IDN-04.md with comprehensive cases for token issuance, one-time secret exposure, hashed persistence guarantees, listing metadata, revocation behavior, and auth middleware validation of revoked/expired tokens. Add backend test code (unit/integration as appropriate) covering positive and negative paths, authorization interactions with role claims, and regression checks against existing auth flows.
acceptance_criteria: IDN-04 has an up-to-date test spec in tests/specs/IDN-04.md
At least one executable test validates each MUST acceptance path for IDN-04
Tests cover revoked and expired token auth rejection
Tests avoid wall-clock flakiness and random nondeterminism

result.summary: Delivered IDN-04 test spec and executable backend coverage for token issuance, hash-only persistence, list metadata, revocation semantics, admin-only token endpoint authorization, and auth middleware rejection/role-claim validation paths.
